0 表示不限制响应头等待，仅新版本支持；流式总时长不由此限制。: 0 means no timeout while waiting for response headers (newer versions only). This does not limit total streaming time.
0 的效果和正值上限由模型决定；自适应思考模型可能忽略固定预算。: The effect of 0 and the maximum positive value depend on the model. Adaptive-thinking models may ignore a fixed budget.
按服务商真实能力填写，不代表模型实际支持该容量。: Enter the capacity supported by your provider. This setting does not add model support.
可用强度取决于模型与 Claude Code 版本。: Available effort levels depend on the model and Claude Code version.
不会默认启用；多代理可能增加请求量和费用。: Not enabled by default. Multiple agents may increase requests and costs.
关闭自动更新后请自行维护客户端安全更新。: If automatic updates are disabled, keep the client updated manually for security.
可用强度取决于模型与 Codex 版本，不会替换您选择的模型。: Available effort levels depend on the model and Codex version. This does not replace your selected model.
官方已弃用风格选择；新版本的 friendly / pragmatic 不再改变: Style selection is deprecated. In newer versions, friendly / pragmatic no longer change the style; none omits built-in personality instructions.
仅在模型支持 Responses verbosity 时生效。: Only applies to models that support Responses verbosity.
子任务模型，不显示在 /model 菜单: Subagent model; not shown in the /model menu
请求超时（毫秒）需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: Request timeout (ms) requires an integer from {0} to {1}
最大输出 Token需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: Maximum output tokens requires an integer from {0} to {1}
思考 Token 预算需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: Thinking token budget requires an integer from {0} to {1}
上下文 Token 上限需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: Context token limit requires an integer from {0} to {1}
自动压缩阈值（%）需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: Auto-compaction threshold (%) requires an integer from {0} to {1}
自动压缩 Token 阈值需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: Auto-compaction token threshold requires an integer from {0} to {1}
数值需要 {0}–{1} 的整数: The value requires an integer from {0} to {1}
此处的供应商与模型配置仅用于外部 AI 工具，不影响卓控台内置 AI。: Provider and model settings here apply only to external AI tools, not to Veylo’s built-in AI.
